exposure: Group 1: uncomplicated cesarean delivery without labor
Group 4: complicated by chorioamnionitis + fetal hypoxia
outcome: cytokine levels in umbilical arterial (UmA) and venous (UmV) blood
finding: Fetal synthesis of IL-6 and IL-8 significantly increases in chorioamnionitis and is further elevated with fetal hypoxia, suggesting fetal origin of these cytokines and concentration-dependent placental clearance mechanisms.
